Class QuantileDataAnalyzer

dataAnalysis.DynamicDataAnalyzerImpl
dataAnalysis.QuantileDataAnalyzer

public class QuantileDataAnalyzer extends DynamicDataAnalyzerImpl

      public QuantileDataAnalyzer(double alfa, double precision, int maxData, double[] quantile, SortAlgorithm sorter)
      Creates a QuantileDataAnalyzer.
      Parameters:
      alfa - the quantile required for the confidence interval
      precision - maximum amplitude of confidence interval (precision = maxamplitude / mean)
      maxData - maximum number of data to be analyzed
      quantile - Requested quantiles //TODO: correct??
      sorter - Sorting algorithm used to manage data

    • QuantileDataAnalyzer

      public QuantileDataAnalyzer(double alfa, double precision, int maxData, double[] quantile)
      Creates a QuantileDataAnalyzer. A default sorting algorithm is used to manage data.
      Parameters:
      alfa - the quantile required for the confidence interval
      precision - maximum amplitude of confidence interval (precision = maxamplitude / mean)
      maxData - maximum number of data to be analyzed
      quantile - Requested quantiles
